Browse or filter D-PLACE cultural variables

Source: R/dp_variables.R
dp_variables.Rd

Browse or filter D-PLACE cultural variables

Usage

dp_variables(var_id = NULL, category = NULL, type = NULL, search = NULL)

Arguments

var_id

Optional character vector of variable IDs to filter to. Also accepts a data frame/tibble with a `var_id` column (e.g. an earlier `dp_variables()` result passed straight through), from which the column is used automatically.

category

Optional character vector of categories to filter to (matched exactly; see `unique(dplace_variables$category)` for valid values), or [contains()] for a partial/regex match. Many `category` values are several topics joined with `", "` (e.g. `"Economy, Property, Subsistence"`), so an exact match like `category = "Subsistence"` misses those – use `category = contains("Subsistence")` instead to match any category string that mentions the term.

type

Optional character vector restricting to variable type(s): `"Categorical"`, `"Ordinal"`, and/or `"Continuous"`. Does not support [contains()].

search

Optional keyword. If given, only variables whose `name` or `description` contains this string (case-insensitive) are returned.

Value

A tibble of variables (see [dplace_variables] for column definitions).

Examples

dp_variables(category = "Subsistence")
#> # A tibble: 69 × 7
#>    var_id        name           description category type  unit  contribution_id
#>    <chr>         <chr>          <chr>       <chr>    <chr> <chr> <chr>          
#>  1 CARNEIRO4_001 Agriculture p… Agricultur… Subsist… Cate… NA    dplace-dataset…
#>  2 CARNEIRO4_002 Agriculture i… Agricultur… Subsist… Cate… NA    dplace-dataset…
#>  3 CARNEIRO4_003 Agricultural … Agricultur… Subsist… Cate… NA    dplace-dataset…
#>  4 CARNEIRO4_004 Improved tech… Improved t… Subsist… Cate… NA    dplace-dataset…
#>  5 CARNEIRO4_005 Soil-working … Soil-worki… Subsist… Cate… NA    dplace-dataset…
#>  6 CARNEIRO4_006 Animal-drawn … Animal-dra… Subsist… Cate… NA    dplace-dataset…
#>  7 CARNEIRO4_007 Fertilization… Fertilizat… Subsist… Cate… NA    dplace-dataset…
#>  8 CARNEIRO4_008 Crop rotation  Crop rotat… Subsist… Cate… NA    dplace-dataset…
#>  9 CARNEIRO4_009 Increasing cu… Area of cu… Subsist… Cate… NA    dplace-dataset…
#> 10 CARNEIRO4_010 Reclamation o… Reclamatio… Subsist… Cate… NA    dplace-dataset…

dp_variables(category = contains("Subsistence"))
